name: Terramind
description: Satellite methane-plume segmentation with TerraMind and PyTorch. Includes a live Streamlit demo, CLI, and local Flask API.

paragraphs: Satellite methane-plume segmentation with a frozen geospatial foundation model, a local inference API, and an interactive dashboard.

Terramind was developed as MethanePulse during a hackathon. It takes a Sentinel-2 GeoTIFF, predicts a plume mask and a relative plume-size class, and exports a georeferenced mask plus a JSON alert. The model uses TerraMind-1.0-small through TerraTorch; the foundation model itself was developed by IBM, ESA, and Forschungszentrum Jülich.

This is a research prototype. Severity is derived from mask area, not a measured methane emission rate. Satellite acquisition gaps, false positives, and performance on real plumes remain open problems. Read the model card before interpreting predictions. The inherited dashboard still contains historical model-card values; the model card in this repository records the evidence and discrepancies explicitly.
features: A Streamlit dashboard with sample-tile inference, tile uploads, an alert log, and a model-card view.
A command-line inference script that writes a binary GeoTIFF mask and JSON alert.
A Flask POST /predict endpoint for local multipart uploads.
Five research notebooks covering data exploration, a spectral baseline, TinyUNet, and the TerraMind model.
The trained checkpoint, sample input, saved sample outputs, and experiment logs.

requirements.text: No local installation, training dataset, or API key is required.
